<set-variable name="tkForm" value="@{
            var form = new JObject();
            var raw = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true) ?? "";
            foreach (var pair in raw.Split('\u0026'))
            {
                if (pair == "") { continue; }
                var idx = pair.IndexOf('=');
                var key = idx == -1 ? pair : pair.Substring(0, idx);
                var val = idx == -1 ? "" : pair.Substring(idx + 1);
                form[Uri.UnescapeDataString(key.Replace('+', ' '))] = Uri.UnescapeDataString(val.Replace('+', ' '));
            }
            return form;
        }" />
        
        <set-variable name="tkScope" value="@{
            var form = (JObject)context.Variables["tkForm"];
            var map = new Dictionary(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach (var entry in "{{mcp-resource-scope-map}}".Split(';'))
            {
                var parts = entry.Split('|');
                if (parts.Length == 2) { map[parts[0].Trim()] = parts[1].Trim(); }
            }
            var resource = (string)form["resource"] ?? "";
            if (resource != "")
            {
                return map.ContainsKey(resource) ? map[resource] : "";
            }
            foreach (var s in ((string)form["scope"] ?? "").Split(' '))
            {
                if (map.ContainsValue(s)) { return s; }
            }
            return "{{mcp-default-scope}}";
        }" />

        @{
            var form = (JObject)context.Variables["tkForm"];
            var amp = "\u0026";
            var parts = new List();
            foreach (var prop in form.Properties())
            {
                if (prop.Name == "resource") { continue; }
                if (prop.Name == "scope") { continue; }
                parts.Add(Uri.EscapeDataString(prop.Name) + "=" + Uri.EscapeDataString((string)prop.Value));
            }
            parts.Add("scope=" + Uri.EscapeDataString((string)context.Variables["tkScope"] + " offline_access"));
            return string.Join(amp, parts);
        }
